name: Ore no SF na Natsuyasumi
source:
Waking up... he was in another world.

When Shou (the protagonist) awoke, he found himself in an unfamiliar world.

Suffering from amnesia, Shou must rely on the help of companions to find a way back from this [other world] to [his original world].
 
[Translated form the Freem! description]
translation:
一觉醒来……他已经到了另一个世界。

当受（主角）醒来时，他发现自己身处一个陌生的世界。

患有失忆症的守必须依靠同伴的帮助才能找到从这个[异世界]回到[原来的世界]的路。
 
[翻译自自由！描述]
